texts:
Tuesday's news, team by team: coach quotes, injury updates and the usage that moves Week 6 calls.

Jaylen Warren keeps the lead job.

TreVeyon Henderson misses multiple weeks.

CeeDee Lamb should be ready for Green Bay.

Let's get into it.
#HereWeGo #NEPats #DallasCowboys

Mike McCarthy called Jaylen Warren "our featured player right now" and said the role holds with Rico Dowdle getting healthy. Warren had 21 touches for 188 yards in Week 5.

RB8 for me @TB. Hold him; a near-even split with Dowdle reopens the sell.
#HereWeGo

Germie Bernard led Pittsburgh with 9 targets and tied for the team high with 28 routes, with three Steelers receivers out. WR33 for me @TB, a low-end WR3.

Pat Freiermuth has 4 TDs in five games. TE12 for me @TB, a borderline start this week.
#HereWeGo

TreVeyon Henderson has a high ankle sprain and misses multiple weeks, no surgery, per Adam Schefter. RB26 rest of season for me; hold him.

Rhamondre Stevenson played 83 percent of the snaps after Henderson left. RB14 for me vs NYJ, borderline RB1/RB2.
#NEPats #JetUp

Stephen Jones said CeeDee Lamb should be ready for Green Bay after the quad bruise vs TB, where he caught 2 of 5 for 9.

Lamb is WR3 for me @GB Sunday night. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DallasCowboys #GoPackGo

Jaxon Smith-Njigba was limited on Seattle's Monday estimate with the ankle he hurt on a run in Week 5, per Bob Condotta. He has a 37.9 percent target share through Week 3.

WR2 for me @DEN Thursday. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

Sean Payton took Denver's play-calling back and wants more balance. J.K. Dobbins ran 18 times for 68 and a TD in that first game. A high-end RB3 for me vs SEA, a high-end flex play.

RJ Harvey had 1 target. Monitor; Thursday's snap split.
#BroncosCountry #Seahawks

DJ Moore sat Monday night with the AC joint sprain, and Adam Schefter says it is not long term. Keon Coleman caught 1 of 2 without him.

Moore is WR23 rest of season for me. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report before @LV.
#BillsMafia #RaiderNation

Ashton Jeanty's touches have dropped four straight weeks, from 29 to 13, and Klint Kubiak says he is beat up. RB11 for me vs BUF, borderline RB1/RB2.

Monitor Jeanty; Wednesday's injury report.
#RaiderNation #BillsMafia

Rashee Rice comes off the bye with the hamstring Ian Rapoport called relatively minor. WR38 for me vs LAC, a low-end flex play to a dart throw, until he practices.

Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#ChiefsKingdom #BoltUp

Kimani Vidal led the Chargers' backs with 42 percent of the snaps vs DEN, up five straight weeks. Add him, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Omarion Hampton played 30 percent, third of three. RB14 rest of season for me; hold him, but a second week third makes him a sell.
#BoltUp

Dave Canales says Jalen Coker is on track to return from the quad, per Joe Person.

Coker is WR18 for me @PHI, a WR2.
#KeepPounding #FlyEaglesFly

Bhayshul Tuten ran 22 times in London, a career high, on 87.5 percent of the early-down snaps. RB18 for me vs HOU, an RB2, and RB18 rest of season.

Trade for Tuten; offer a WR3 and a bench back.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

David Montgomery is week to week with the groin.

Woody Marks played 56 of 65 snaps at TEN once Montgomery left. RB19 for me @JAX, an RB2.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

Cam Skattebo lost his fourth fumble in five games, but he took 63 percent of the running back snaps @WAS. RB16 for me vs NO, an RB2. Hold him.

Jameis Winston threw for 326 and 3 TDs. QB16 for me, a streamer. Stream him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#NYGiants #Saints

Alvin Kamara played 12 snaps vs MIN with a back injury. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.

Kendre Miller led New Orleans with 10 carries and a TD on 14 snaps. Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#Saints

Tyler Shough has played two weeks in protective layers on his non-throwing hand, and Kellen Moore would not say whether it is broken.

Shough is QB11 for me @NYG, a borderline start this week. Monitor; Wednesday's injury report.
#Saints #NYGiants

Michael Wilson has 51 targets in five games, 10.2 a game, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is in Houston now. WR17 for me @LAR, a WR2.

Trade for Wilson; offer a bench receiver.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Jeremiyah Love ran 12 times for 22 vs DET, and Tyler Allgeier kept the passing downs. Love is still the early-down back, RB21 for me @LAR, an RB2.

Hold Love; Allgeier taking early downs too makes him a sell.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse

Denzel Boston ran a route on 91 percent of the dropbacks @PIT and drew 7 targets, a 22 percent share. WR19 for me vs BAL, a WR2. Hold him.

Ja'Kobi Lane could return from IR this week. Stash him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#DawgPound #RavensFlock

Colston Loveland caught 2 of 5 with the backups throwing, and Caleb Williams is on track to practice Wednesday. TE4 rest of season for me; hold him.

Williams is QB13 for me @ATL, a borderline start this week. Monitor; Wednesday's practice report.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

Every note from today is on the Pass, with Wednesday's injury reports next.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Menu and Thursday's lineup calls, and repost this for your league.
